form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Perdue (for himself, Mr. Barrasso, Mrs. Blackburn, Mr. Boozman, Mr. Cruz, Ms. Ernst, Mr. Grassley, Mr. Hoeven, Mrs. Hyde-Smith, Mr. Inhofe, Mr. Isakson, Mr. Kennedy, Mr. Lankford, Mr. Moran, Mr. Rounds, Mr. Rubio, Mr. Sasse, and Mr. Sullivan) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs

form.official-title: To amend the Consumer Financial Protection Act of 2010 to subject the Bureau of Consumer Financial Protection to the regular appropriations process, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau Accountability Act of 2019.

section.header: Subjecting the Bureau of Consumer Financial Protection to the regular appropriations process

subsection.text: Section 1017 of the Consumer Financial Protection Act of 2010 (12 U.S.C. 5497) is amended—

subparagraph.text: in the subsection heading, by striking “Transfer of Funds From Board Of Governors.—” and inserting Budget and Financial Management.—;
by redesignating paragraphs (4) and (5) as paragraphs (1) and (2), respectively; and

clause.text: in the paragraph heading, by striking Budget and financial management.— and inserting In general.—;

paragraph.text: by redesignating subsection (e) as subsection (b); and

subparagraph.text: by striking paragraphs (1) through (3) and inserting the following:

paragraph.text: There is authorized to be appropriated such funds as may be necessary to carry out this title for fiscal year 2021.

subsection.text: The amendments made by this Act shall take effect on October 1, 2020.
